---
title: "Prose"
subtitle: "Links, lists, quotes, and the divider"
---

Article links are weight 600, with no underline. A link inside a paragraph
gets a quiet highlight. Hover shifts from the link color to the tertiary color.

A [highlighted link](headings.qmd) sits in a sentence. **Strong** and *emphasis*
stay in the body face. A marked word is [kept visible]{.mark}.

## Lists

Markers use the tertiary color.

- First unordered item
- Second unordered item
  - Nested item

1. First ordered step
2. Second ordered step

Term
: A definition stays in the same measure as the paragraph above it.

## Quote

> The quote rule is a 3px bar in the link color. The text color stays the body
> color rather than a muted aside.

## Divider

Headings do not supply this line. Authors opt in with `---`.

---

The line is 1px, using the content divider token, at full opacity.

## Limits

The theme contains a paragraph link and a nested list inside the measure.
A paragraph used as a heading, or a list item that is an entire section, should
be rewritten as a heading plus a short paragraph.
